config.threshold_note: Context threshold: auto, so a turn is flagged when its context exceeded 80% of the context window of the model that SERVED it, not a fixed token count (window table checked 2026-10-01; a model the table has no row for is never flagged and is named below). No cost is estimated: per-token pricing depends on commercial terms this framework cannot know, so tokens and wall time are recorded and money is left to whoever knows the rates (decision record 0004).
